description.en: Speedily swings a torch that can instantly destroy your plants.
description.zh: 转动火把，秒杀你的植物。

chat.en: Monks in the Shaolin Temple practice day and night. Thanks to Torch Monk Zombie making everyone think the sun never sets.
chat.zh: 少林寺的武僧夜以继日地训练。多亏火把武僧让大家以为太阳一直不落山。

text.en: torch destroys a plant on contact, including that are short
text.zh: 火把迅速烧毁接触到的植物，包括低矮植物
冰冻攻击能使火把熄灭
